cards.title: Vertex-model elastic energy

checks.reason: The energy and all moduli are printed in the model section and parameter table.
A cell at both target values contributes zero energy and every contribution is nonnegative.

cards.numerical_form: Compute unwrapped toroidal polygon areas/perimeters in float64 and sum the two quadratic penalties.

cards.title: Exact polygon energy gradient

checks.reason: The appendix derives area and perimeter contributions from the same elastic energy, including the one-half area-edge factor.
Shoelace-area and edge-length derivatives give the appendix factor one half per area edge.
A preimplementation central-difference calculation on independent convex polygons agrees with the shoelace/perimeter derivative to 3.9e-10; the production implementation must repeat this regression.

cards.numerical_form: Accumulate each cell's analytic area/perimeter gradient onto its incident vertices.
open_questions: Main-text prose omits the appendix factor one half; fresh-context review is required.

cards.title: Overdamped sheared vertex dynamics
cards.latex: \dot{\mathbf r}_j=\zeta^{-1}(\mathbf F_j+v\sum_{c\ni j}w_{cj}\hat{\mathbf n}_c)+\dot\gamma y_j\hat{\mathbf x}

checks.reason: Drag, shear term, Lees--Edwards boundary, and zeta=1 are printed.
For zero activity and shear, dr/dt=-grad(E)/zeta gives dE/dt=-|grad(E)|^2/zeta, so the continuous dynamics is dissipative.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate nonaffine motion in reduced coordinates while evolving and periodically remapping the sheared box matrix.

cards.title: Rotational diffusion

checks.reason: The noise covariance and Dr=0.5 are printed.
Scaling a standard normal increment by sqrt(2 Dr dt) gives exactly the printed covariance in the Euler--Maruyama discretization.

cards.numerical_form: Euler--Maruyama angular increments from a reproducible NumPy generator.

cards.title: Active-force weighting

checks.reason: The numerator and denominator are explicitly defined next to Eq. (5).
At a trivalent vertex each of the three physical edges contributes to two cell-local incident sums, so sum(l_c)=2 L_T and the printed weights sum to 1/6.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate local incident edge lengths from the current toroidal tiling; do not renormalize the printed factor 12.
open_questions: The printed weights sum to one sixth for an ideal trivalent vertex; this is retained rather than silently changed.

cards.title: T1 neighbor exchange

checks.reason: The cell-incidence transition and lT1=0.07 are printed.
The incidence replacement removes one alpha-beta edge and adds one gamma-delta edge without changing V, E, or F; trivalence and the torus Euler characteristic are preserved.

cards.numerical_form: Flip a short edge, update four ordered cell cycles, and place the new edge perpendicular to the old one.
open_questions: The post-flip edge length is not printed and must be convergence-tested.

cards.title: Cell virial stress

checks.reason: The per-cell stress and averaging protocol are printed.
The sum of forces contributed by one translationally invariant polygon energy is zero, so adding a common offset to all r_i leaves the virial unchanged.

cards.numerical_form: Compute each periodic cell in a locally unwrapped frame, then average its xy virial over cells, strain window, and seeds.
open_questions: Exact steady-state discard and averaging strain are not printed.

cards.title: Newtonian viscosity and VFT fit

checks.reason: The definition and VFT form are printed in the Fig. 3 caption/text.
Taking log eta makes the reported VFT form linear in 1/(v-v_c) conditional on v_c; the numerical fit must still report leave-one-out stability.

cards.numerical_form: Fit only declared low-rate points; never infer fit windows from source pixels.
open_questions: The paper does not print the exact fit window or all shear rates.

cards.title: Shear-thickening slope criteria

checks.reason: epsilon=0.2 and delta=0.1 are explicitly printed.
Centered finite differences in log coordinates return exactly one for a Newtonian sigma proportional to gamma_dot; target acceptance separately quantifies grid sensitivity.

cards.numerical_form: Use centered log derivatives in the interior and one-sided endpoints; report grid-limited Gmax.

cards.title: Peclet scaling collapse

checks.reason: The proposed rescaling and proportionality are printed in the Fig. 7 caption/text.
If thickening occurs at Pe=1 and tau_f is proportional to eta/v^2, algebra gives the printed inverse-onset relation; empirical target acceptance compares it with alternatives.

cards.numerical_form: Regress in log space with uncertainty and compare preregistered alternative scalings.
open_questions: The v^-2 factor is motivated empirically rather than derived from the microscopic dynamics.
